definitions.explanation: The original sum of money invested or lent, as distinct from any interest or profit earned on it.

examples.japanese: {元金|がんきん}を{返済|へんさい}する。
{利息|りそく}だけでなく{元金|がんきん}も{減|へ}らしていかなければならない。
examples.english: You need to reduce not just the interest but also the principal.

examples.japanese: {投資|とうし}した{元金|がんきん}を{回収|かいしゅう}するまでに{三年|さんねん}かかった。
examples.english: It took three years to recoup the original investment.

notes:
Composed of {元|がん} (original, base) + {金|きん} (money). A fundamental financial term. Can also be read もときん, though がんきん is more standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {元金|がんきん}{返済|へんさい} (principal repayment)
- {元金|がんきん}{均等|きんとう}{返済|へんさい} (equal principal repayment)
- {元金|がんきん}を{回収|かいしゅう}する (recoup the principal)
- {元金|がんきん}{保証|ほしょう} (principal guarantee)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {元手|もとで} — capital, seed money (more colloquial, often for starting a business)
- {資本|しほん} — capital (broader economic term)
- {利息|りそく} — interest (the return on the principal, the counterpart concept)
- {元本|がんぽん} — principal (close synonym, slightly more formal/legal)
